mapAuthority: Exact caller-supplied SHA256 checked before JSON parsing; no environment override, original-path fallback or inferred mapping
target: Explicit normalized archive-relative archivePath; every ancestor and final file opened beneath the canonical archive root with O_NOFOLLOW
rowBinding: Hash and parse the copied original manifest; each explicitly indexed row must exactly match originalPath, expected SHA and byte count. Multiple identical original descriptors may be coalesced only through explicit manifestRows indices.

coverage.selected-rows: Only declared rows verified; no full archive/manifest preservation claim
coverage.all-rows: Every original manifest row index must be covered exactly once

limits.targetPayload: Stream SHA/size only; no payload execution or JSON conversion

originalRelativePaths: Historical ../ strings may exist as literal descriptor identities. They never become filesystem access paths.
mutableReadmeRule: No entry for unavailable24e4 old bytes. The3e5992 exclusive snapshot is a separately identified observation, never a replacement for old24e4.
